scope: Independent Lower and LLVM boundary code/evidence review; joint full gates and remaining Analyze/Verify findings are separate obligations
reasoning: Both Lower and LLVM bind against VerifiedModule and independently inspect Parameter actual index, actual parameter Local Closure type, return Closure identity, unique role, role index/kind, and Returned cleanup. Missing/out-of-range/inconsistent boundaries reject.

Fresh admission path preserves prior behavior; forwarding does not replace the actual verified CFG/Call/Return or synthesize a new environment. The existing aggregate layout, TakeLocal liveness and drop flags remain the representation.
New per-function guards inspect fixed fields, bounds-checked indexes and a required singleton role slice; no unbounded new traversal, allocation or codegen cache is introduced.

Author final-candidate machine receipts separately report final normal replay and historical allocator runs reused only with byte-identical LLVM IR. Those historical runs are not relabeled as final executions.

Root inspected consumer256 execution harness against frozen source-operation oracle: exact exit/stdout, all six allocator fields and live0, actual linker wrapper and no fallback; future common-candidate full run must also pass.
limitations: This review is not whole-language safety acceptance. Analyze253 and Verify254 review failures remain blocking until independently repaired.
No Rust runtime/RSS performance comparison or Windows native product claim.
